programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Fully Funny - Eric Kot / 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: Aces Go Places V / 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak to steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove. White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: Seven Years Itch / 七年之癢
programme.desc: Living together for 7 years, Raymond has been faithful to Sylvia. But he is eager to having an affair after being teased by his colleagues. On his business trip to Singapore, he is being used by a charming girl, Siu Hung to smuggle some stolen jewelry. Raymond mistakes for love luck yet he fails to have an affair with Siu Hung before she sneaks away with the jewelry. When he returns home, a diamond ring is found in his luggage and Sylvia takes it as her birthday present. Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. He requests Sylvia to act if they were first met, but it comes an intruder Money who falls in love with Sylvia at first sight...

programme.title: Parking Service / 代客泊車
programme.desc: Stanley was an optimistic youth, feeling bored in his pig-rearing job, he decided to part with his beloved uncle and aunt and seek for an ideal job to achieve his own goal in life. He then found a job in Tsim Sha Tsui East. There he worked as a member of a parking service team and befriended one of his colleagues Ah Man. Ah Man was a reticent guy who was always frustrated by reality. The problem that he could not afford his sister to further studies in oversea puzzled him now and then. His anxiety was intensified by his sorrowful devotion to a mysterious beautiful girl Stella. Stanley was enthusiastic to help Ah Man to be acquainted with Stella. This made Ah Man live in high spirits. Stanley also encouraged his colleagues to work with enthusiasm. Their team was therefore rewarded with more tips by customers. A member of another team was a man of misconduct who stole spare parts and valuables from customer's cars. Mr. Yang, was a man who made fake banknotes...

programme.title: Monster Wore Jeans / 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them...

programme.title: Hitman / 殺手之王
programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: Anna Magdalena / 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.

programme.title: Summer Holiday / 夏日的麼麼茶
programme.desc: Summer flies to an island to sell a resort that is invested by her and her cousin. She meets Momocha who claims to be the authentic owner of the hotel. They begin a battle of love...

programme.title: Running Out Of Time / 暗戰
programme.desc: Andy has only 14 days left in his life. He burglars a Diamond Trading Company and hence arouses the attention of a Police Negotiator, Sean...

programme.title: Superstars Sunday: Give Love A Chance / 爆谷星影好戲: 緣份新天空
programme.desc: Kelvin and Ellie are lovers. They have been living together for 3 years in Toronto. Yet Ellie's bossy and possessive character always turns Kelvin into a mocking target from his colleagues. Kelvin finally reaches his tolerant limit and decides to end their relationship. Rhea, Kelvin's boss at work, makes use of her birthday party to cheer him up. The drunken Kelvin encounters May, just when she is dumped by her boyfriend. Two lonely hearts entwine and rapidly get married after just 7 days. Despite the strong objection from May's parents as well as Kelvin's ex-girlfriend Ellie. Ellie even bets that their relationship won't last for more than 3 months...

programme.title: Hot War / 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: Parking Service / 代客泊車
programme.desc: Stanley was an optimistic youth, feeling bored in his pig-rearing job, he decided to part with his beloved uncle and aunt and seek for an ideal job to achieve his own goal in life. He then found a job in Tsim Sha Tsui East. There he worked as a member of a parking service team and befriended one of his colleagues Ah Man. Ah Man was a reticent guy who was always frustrated by reality. The problem that he could not afford his sister to further studies in oversea puzzled him now and then. His anxiety was intensified by his sorrowful devotion to a mysterious beautiful girl Stella. Stanley was enthusiastic to help Ah Man to be acquainted with Stella. This made Ah Man live in high spirits. Stanley also encouraged his colleagues to work with enthusiasm. Their team was therefore rewarded with more tips by customers. A member of another team was a man of misconduct who stole spare parts and valuables from customer's cars. Mr. Yang, was a man who made fake banknotes...

programme.title: Monster Wore Jeans / 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them...

programme.title: Hitman / 殺手之王

After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: Fighting For Love / 同居蜜友
programme.desc: Tung Choi is the third-generation shop owner of a string of beef noodle restaurants. He gets into a minor fender bender with the hard working, yet outwardly mean Deborah. The two engage in an ill-tempered spat which makes both characters seem completely unlikable. Meeting later to negotiate a truce, the two end up engaging in a one-night stand, but a happy ending is far from possible. Tung is linked to high-maintenance TV personality Mindy, and Deborah is about to encounter a fitting fall from grace. Thanks to her mean-spirited behavior, she loses her job, her home (she and her father have a spat), and possibly her self-respect. Deborah and Tung encounter each other at the hospital, where Tung is visiting his mother and Deborah is staying (as in sleeping on the floor) with her sister. Tung offers to let her freshen up at his home, but she ends up sleeping on the couch for a short period of time. Tung's extremely weird family seems against Deborah; they tout Mindy's positive p

programme.title: The Royal Scoundrel / 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the triad group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk...

programme.title: Wu Yen / 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power...

programme.title: Give Love A Chance / 緣份新天空
programme.desc: Kelvin and Ellie are lovers. They have been living together for 3 years in Toronto. programme.title: Skyline Cruisers / 神偷次世代
programme.desc: Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them...

programme.title: Twinkle, Twinkle Lucky Stars / 夏日福星
programme.desc: Muscles, Kidstuff, Fung, and the gang are taking a well-needed vacation in Thailand courtesy of the Hong Kong police department. Also on the trip is police inspector Woo on orders to track down a list of drug dealers from informant Ma. Unfortunately, Ma gets whacked by a Thai crime lord, but he tells Woo as he draws his last breath that he mailed the list to his friend in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Muscles and the gang are shaking down Lau, a drug dealer who, it turns out, is being targeted by the same baddies that killed Ma...

programme.title: Kung Fu Cult-Master / 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conqueror...

programme.title: The Inspector Wears Skirts II / 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them...

programme.title: Lee Rock 1 / 五億探長雷洛傳雷老虎
programme.desc: Andy Lau leads a star-studded cast in this chronicle of one young officer's rise to power within the Hong Kong police force in the 1950s.

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Eastern Condors / 「武」績「彪」炳: 東方禿鷹
programme.desc: “Eastern Condors” was the top secret mission of Department of Defense in the United States in 1987. The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. Since it was the top secret mission, Lieutenant Lam could only select felons from the Federal prison lured by the right of residence and big money to execute the mission. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end...

programme.title: Final Run / 目中無人
programme.desc: MA and KAU were the Senior Inspectors of Narcotics Bureau. They were smuggling with the Golden Triangle in Thailand. CHEUNG – an officer of Custom Department. CHEUNG and MA were good friend since they studied in the University. MA's group wanted to get more help in custom, he asked CHEUNG to be his partner, but CHEUNG refused. While KAU was very hasty, he killed all CHEUNG's family. Then, CHEUNG wanted to take revenge against them. However, MA and KAU made a plan to get CHEUNG into trouble. At last, CHEUNG escaped to Thailand and stayed at his aunt's house. MA and KAU knew that CHEUNG escaped to Thailand, so they tried their best to kill him, but they did not succeed...

programme.title: Viva Erotica / 色情男女
programme.desc: Leslie is a young film director whose works had poor box office. Being unemployed, he gets an offer to direct a vulgar commercial film. He has to succumb to the reality...

programme.title: Wu Yen / 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. programme.title: The New Legend of Shaolin / 洪熙官
programme.desc: Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hung's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hung killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting, to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found...

programme.title: Eastern Condors / 東方禿鷹
programme.desc: “Eastern Condors” was the top secret mission of Department of Defense in the United States in 1987. The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. Since it was the top secret mission, Lieutenant Lam could only select felons from the Federal prison lured by the right of residence and big money to execute the mission. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end...

programme.title: The Chinese Feast / 金玉滿堂
programme.desc: Directed by Tsui Hark, a comedy with star cast led by Leslie Cheung. Two rival chefs must unite and compete against an egotistical master gourmet chef for 'The #1 Chef' title.

programme.title: Where's Officer Tuba / 霹靂大喇叭
programme.desc: Tuba is a policeman, but because of his timid character, he spends his days in the Police Band as a tuba player. Inspector Chow sees the potential in Tuba and arranges him to investigate the case together. Unfortunately, Chow gets killed at work, but his ghost helps Tuba to crackdown on the villains...

programme.title: Bury Me High / 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: Two geomancers are roaming a wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler...

programme.title: Sleazy Dizzy / 小偷阿星
programme.desc: Lung was an informer of Police in the triad society. But his identity was exposed and lost all memory after hurt. All of money that given by the Police was lost. The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. But Wu won't do that because of their friendship...

programme.title: From Riches To Rags / 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: Curry & Pepper / 咖喱辣椒
programme.desc: Two cops--both best friends and partners--both become the subject of a beautiful news reporter's documentary. The two soon find themselves competing for screen time as well as the love of the reporter while after a murderous arms dealer.

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Peacock King / 「武」績「彪」炳: 孔雀王子
programme.desc: Ashura, the beautiful daughter of Hell King, is awakened from centuries of sleep when her tower is shattered by evil Raga's powers. Raga then guides Ashura to modern day Tokyo where they wreak gory havoc. Ashura is important to the forces of evil, as she holds the key to Hell Gate where the Hell King is imprisoned. Once set free, the Hell King is determined to turn the world into mincemeat. Two young men, Peacock and Lucky Fruit descend on Tokyo simultaneously with identical mission. They meet by accident. Thanks to pretty Okada, they become good friends...

programme.title: Paper Marriage / 過埠新娘
programme.desc: Boxer Bo is an unlucky gambler, constantly on the look-out for a quick way to make money. He finds marriage is easier and more lucrative than being subjected to bizarre scientific experiments. The lady Jade is completely in love with her boyfriend Peter and gives him all her money when she arrives. Peter convinces Jade to temporarily marry Bo so that she can clear immigration and eventually become his bride. She accepts only to discover that Peter just wanted her money...

programme.title: Last Ghost Standing / 鬼請你睇戲
programme.desc: GV Broadway Cinema is the oldest cinema in the city and it'll be demolished soon. The cinema has always been dark and cold, so it became the last place for the ghost to stay. Yang Yang found a temporary job in the cinema. But this is the last day of his job, so he brings his girlfriend Yiu-yiu to watch the last movie, not realizing a horrible nightmare is coming...

programme.title: Alan & Eric Between Hello & Goodbye / 雙城故事
programme.desc: After having grown up to lead wildly separate lives, two reunited boyhood pals pledge to maintain their friendship at all costs but both fall in love with the same woman.

programme.title: A Taste of Killing and Romance / 殺手的童話
programme.desc: Judge was one of the top killers of ICE's syndicate. Mr. Tung Fai, a super cop attempted to sue the Triad head, Godfather “Tiger”. Unfortunately, his witness gave false testimony. Worst still, the witness was shot by Judge who impersonated as the presiding Judge in the law court. Meanwhile, Judge met Ru-fung, sister of Ice and both fell in love. The two killers understood they could not have true love. They decided to enjoy love for 3 days, and then separate and return to their killing carrier again.

programme.title: From Riches To Rags / 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: The Sword / 名劍
programme.desc: Swords, like diamonds, sometimes carry a curse. And the famous sword Chi Mud is such a sword. When swordmaster Wah acquires Chi Mud, he is advised to destroy it or he will be killed by this very sword. Wah does not listen. He has already retired into seclusion and does not think the young swordsmen can find and challenge him. Li is such a young swordsman. He even has dueled and killed another young challenger. Li by accident saves a young girl from a professional killer. In a few days, the girl and Li become friends. But the girl leaves in anger when Li meets his old flame Hsiao Yue, now married to Lin Wan. Li is ambushed by killer Chan...

programme.title: Happy Ghost IV / 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Sum Kwai is enjoying a second life in metropolis Hong Kong. His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Lawrence Cheng / 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: Daddy, Father And Papa / 老豆唔怕多
programme.desc: As with any other child of his age, seven-years-old Benny takes delight in getting into mischief and is a constant headache to his teachers and classmates. One day, his naughty ways finally led him into serious trouble. A list of triad members has fallen into his hands and he was kidnapped by the notorious gangsters. Thinking it was one of his usual pranks, his dad was undisturbed by Benny's sudden disappearance and made no attempt to trace his whereabouts. However, providence is on Benny's side for a policeman and a reporter are hot pursuit of him, as they both believed Benny to be their son...

programme.title: Dragon Lord / 龍少爺
programme.desc: Dragon and Kan are childhood friends who spend most of their free time chasing after local girls in general and spying on one in particular who catches their eyes. A gang in the nearby dwelling is smuggling precious artifacts to westerners. Hai Huo is a reluctant party to the scheme and when he voiced his objection, the big boss sent his henchmen after him to keep him quiet. When the mischievous duo came across Hai Huo, who was hiding in their village, they take on the gang to protect the artifacts.

programme.title: Flirting Scholar / 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: Tong Park Foo is the top-grade scholar in Suzhou. On a feast day, Tong and his friends go to visit the temple and there, Tong meets Chau Heung for the first time. Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride?

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Peter Lai / 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us?

programme.title: Great Pretenders / 千王
programme.desc: Swindler Mr. Giant loses in a poker match against swindler Wong Sheung Chin and they become sworn enemies. Meanwhile, Wong's apprentice Snake Wai meets Susan, a widow whom recently returned to Hong Kong from Singapore. Planning to con a big sum of money from her, Wai sets up a plan with his acquaintances Yam Sei-sung and Yip Mei-mei. However, Susan turns out to be a swindler as well. Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan...

programme.title: Tempting Heart / 心動
programme.desc: Ho-jun is a shy youngster, more interested in his guitar than school. A chance encounter between Ho-jun and Sheo-rou leads to a first sweet taste of romance. However...

programme.title: Till Death Shall We Start / 衰鬼撬牆腳
programme.desc: David died as a virgin and the Doomsday Book says a virgin ghost has no right for reincarnation until he deflowers a virgin human, so David assumes the human shape and goes after Lisa. Lisa's boyfriend Landal however finds out David is a ghost. He warns Lisa but she won't listen...

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: On The Run / 「武」績「彪」炳: 亡命鴛鴦
programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers...

programme.title: Heartbeat 100 / 心跳一百
programme.desc: Maggie, Chu Chu and Weeny Eyes spend their holidays in a small village. One night, Maggie witnesses a murder at a gypsum sculpture shop right opposite their house. But when the police arrive, nothing has happened to the shop owner and his mentally retarded nephew. Maggie is suspicious and sneaks into the shop but is discovered by the shop owner. Nam, a police inspector who is investigating a robbery case...

programme.title: All's Well, Ends Well 97 / 97家有囍事
programme.desc: Old Mr. Lao has three sons and the youngest one Lao Kung is his favorite. However, Kung does nothing but fool around all day long. Old Mr. Lao is very annoyed about this. The relationship between father and son is thus affected. So on Kung‘s birthday, his two brothers decide to play a joke on him. They trick him into believing he has won the lottery. Kung is so happy that he spends a tremendous amount of money. When he realizes he is in huge debt, he pretends to go insane and the whole family believes him. They take great care of him and confide in him. It is this pretence that makes Kung grows up and he and his father finally end in good terms.

programme.title: Fun & Fury / 痴情快婿
programme.desc: Leon busts an international drug ring at Singapore in a startling fight sequence that will shock even the most jaded filmgoer. From there on it's laughs galore when Leon arrives on Hong Kong with his wife to be who is then kidnapped by her own father who objects to her marrying a police officer. Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue!

programme.title: Fighting to Survive / 一蚊雞保鑣
programme.desc: Bon Bon, a resident of Tuen Mun, who's always attempting to implement his latest pyramid scheme. Bon Bon rescues a lady from a lecher occasionally and decides to implement his latest scheme, 'One Dollar Bodyguard'. He'll protect women on their evening strolls for one HK dollar. Bon Bon has to attend to his own problem, which is his inability to ride in a moving vehicle, that strands him in Tuen Mun for life. And there's the romantic issue with Snooker to resolve...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sandra Ng / 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer?

programme.title: Great Pretenders / 千王
programme.desc: Swindler Mr. Giant loses in a poker match against swindler Wong Sheung Chin and they become sworn enemies. Meanwhile, Wong's apprentice Snake Wai meets Susan, a widow whom recently returned to Hong Kong from Singapore. Planning to con a big sum of money from her, Wai sets up a plan with his acquaintances Yam Sei-sung and Yip Mei-mei. However, Susan turns out to be a swindler as well. Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan...

programme.title: A Chinese Ghost Story / 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: A rainstorm compelled Ling to trespass Lan Po Temple for a night. Ling meets attractive Siu Seen. Being unaware of Lit's murder, he is madly in love with Siu Seen...

programme.title: Eighteen Springs / 半生緣
programme.desc: Xu Shuhui introduced his friend Ku Manjing to Shen Shijun and they fell deeply in love. However, since his father was seriously ill, he had to stay in Nanjing to take care of his family business. This affected their relationship and they cooled down on each other. On the other side, Xu was ashamed of his poor family background and did not reveal his love for Shi Chuizhi. In the end, Shen was urged by his stepmother and married his cousin Shi, Ku was set up by her sister Manlu and her husband Zhu Hongcai. She was raped by Zhu and gave birth to a baby. Ten years later, Shen chanced upon Ku...

programme.title: Mission Of Justice / 金三角群英會
programme.desc: BULLET and MOON are two tough ladies who are out to bust the biggest drug syndicate in Thailand and they only have ten days to do it! Nothing is beyond these fighting women as they enter the Golden triangle unafraid because they are on a “MISSION OF JUSTICE”! Through the jungle they pursue the dangerous Yie Feng as they track her into the very heart of Cala. Working under-cover they both find their lives at risk to the deadly Drug Lords. Only their superior fighting skills can keep them from being killed...

programme.title: Romantic Dream / 追女仔95之綺夢
programme.desc: Dino Sau is a brilliant motor mechanic, able to supply a Mini Cooper with an engine powered by atomic energy. He falls in love with a beautiful, filthy-rich girl Vivian, but of course she already has a boyfriend. Years later, Dino is rich, and he meets his beloved again. She is now married to Gao Kun. Dino seeks the advice of an evil-minded guru, who implants him with dreams in which he can have his object of desire...

programme.title: Lucky Stars Go Places / 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: The Kung Fu Scholar / 倫文敘老點柳先開
programme.desc: Lun was a smart scholar who liked to do petty tricks. Lau had been practicing martial arts. Lun and Lau formed an odd couple of school and had small disputes all the time.

programme.title: The Inspector Wears Skirts / 霸王花
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out...

programme.title: Freedom Run / 太子爺出差
programme.desc: Te-pei sets up an Angel's Dust scan but finds himself trapped by Hong Kong police led by Chang. They are ordered to cooperate to crack the narcotize ring and suspect rich Chen as the kingpin. This leads to a Yunan martial arts troupe. Chang falls in love with the troupe's star, Hung. Police raid the troupe but find nothing as Hung has unwittingly taken the narcotics. She wants to smuggle herself to America, only to find herself chased by police and traffickers...

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Iceman Cometh / 「武」績「彪」炳: 急凍奇俠
programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.

programme.title: Scared Stiff / 小生夢驚魂
programme.desc: Miao and his good friend Halley are roommates. One day, they run into a robbery and get involved in a traffic accident. Halley suffers slight injuries but Miao is dead for all purposes except his brain wave is still active. However, when Halley cries over his 'corpse', Miao bursts into explosive life. Then, Miao takes part in a brain wave experiment that drastically changes his life...Meanwhile, Halley is targeted for revenge after identifying the robbers...

programme.title: 3 Days Of A Blind Girl / 盲女七十二小時
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife...

programme.title: Queen of Underworld / 夜生活女王霞姐傳奇
programme.desc: Young Har Jay starts as a waitress in a low-class restaurant. Like all young girls, she falls for handsome young men. One of them makes her pregnant. Determined to keep the baby by all means, Har Jay surrenders herself to police detective Guan who manages to silence the father. Later on, she becomes the head hostess of a cabaret and is famous for the way she trains inexperienced girls. Buwhay, Har Jay's daughter, grows up and revolts. She goes for an upstart mobster, Chao, and runs away from Har Jay...

programme.title: Days Of Being Wild / 阿飛正傳
programme.desc: A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers and his friends before leaving them all to the Philippines in search of the truth...

programme.title: A Moment Of Romance / 天若有情
programme.desc: Wah Dee handles cars and bikes like a racing champion. To keep the police off his trail, he takes Jo Jo hostage. On the run, their desperate love is doomed from the start....

programme.title: The Killer / 喋血雙雄
programme.desc: Jeffery is a hired killer who blinds a singer Jennie during his last job. Feeling guilty, he picks a contract to kill a head of a drug syndicate to pay for her eye operation...

programme.title: Princess D / 想飛
programme.desc: When Joker meets Ling in a disco one night, he feels she is the perfect model of his dream project 'princess-d'. In reality, however, Ling is the opposite of the perfect image...

programme.title: Iceman Cometh / 急凍奇俠
programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.

programme.title: Never Ending Summer / 吳三桂與陳圓圓
programme.desc: Chan Tai Yuen had planned to migrate to Canada, he found out that his wife was having an affair with a foreigner. Chan had already transferred the ownership of the house and the car to his wife. Suddenly Chan lost everything. Chan met Ng Sam Kwi, Chan had nowhere to go and thus moved into Ng's house. They gradually fell in love with each other. Would Ng change herself for her love?

programme.title: Crazy Companies 2 / 最佳損友闖情關
programme.desc: Kwai's brother owed the Fok's family two million and Fok's manager Robert persuaded to merge Fu's company. The three pals joined Fok's to solve the crisis...

programme.title: Fractured Follies / 長短腳之戀
programme.desc: Since Nam has been swindled of his life savings by his scheming cousin on a ruined site, his crippled daughter May takes up the hard task of turning the premise into a supermarket. May is injured in a traffic accident caused by taxi-driver Joe who assumes his reckless driving has made May a cripple. He then volunteers to help her to set up the supermarket. Love blossoms. Joe sells his taxi in order to invest in the supermarket, forcing his brother, Sea, and sister, Cher to work there too. Sea falls for May's cousin Scarlet who fancies only Joe...

programme.title: Okinawa Rendez-vous / 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: Taoism Drunkard / 鬼馬天師
programme.desc: In the Taoist Temple of Dragon Tiger Mountain, there lived a Drunken Taoist whose behavior and appearance were different from ordinary people. He was punished to find a virgin boy who was born in the year of 'Sun Mou', the 15th of August of midnight for the consecration of new idol. In order to find that virgin boy, he was unfortunately involved in a murdering case. Many years ago, in the Science Clan, there was a Starry Devil who was cruel and brutal and often committed the rules of the Clan. On one occasion, while he was trying to steal the Leader's Writ, he was being discovered and punished by peeling off his hand's skin then expelled out of the Clan. Wu's grandmother was one of the executors and also the protector of the writ...

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Once Upon A Time In China / 「武」績「彪」炳: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: In 1875, Wong Fei Hung and his disciples take on the unscrupulous dealers who are trying to entice gullible civilians into slavery in America.

programme.title: First Option / 飛虎
programme.desc: Wong and his team are forced to team up with a bungling customs squad and their greenhorn leader, who happens to be a woman, to bring in a huge shipment of heroine...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E8 -Tree Tales / 尚比亞野生故事 第8集 - 樹木傳說
programme.desc: Trees are Africa’s oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths’ most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Planet Weird S1E5 -Fight Club / 奇異地球 第5集 - 鬥陣俱樂部

programme.title: Planet Weird S1E6 -Gangsters / 奇異地球 第6集 - 野性黑幫
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches who’ve developed a taste for blood.

programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world’s 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature’s best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E1 -River of Life / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第1集 - 生命之河
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: Rooted S1E5 -The Hollow Heart / 紮根 第5集 - 空心木
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast / 海洋饕餮盛宴
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet’s biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa’s east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E5 -Crystal, Elsa and Thor / 動物知心友 第5集 - 克莉絲朵、艾莎與索爾
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E6 -Ozzy, Riri, and Gaia / 動物知心友 第6集 - 奧茲、瑞瑞與蓋亞
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary / 祕「蜜」日記
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E3 -Savanna / 王者爭霸 第3集 - 疏林草原
programme.desc: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether it’s head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries S1E1 -Haven of Giants / 肯亞野生日記 第1集 - 巨人避難所
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. They've also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants’ needs - and to see if they're returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E1 -Iceland: Fire / 迷忘國度 第1集 - 冰島:火
programme.desc: Learn about the world’s largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E2 -Iceland: Ice / 迷忘國度 第2集 - 冰島:冰
programme.desc: Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E3 -Bay of Fundy / 迷忘國度 第3集 - 芬迪灣
programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundy’s surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the world’s fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E4 -Wales / 迷忘國度 第4集 - 威爾斯
programme.desc: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the world’s longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E5 -Ireland / 迷忘國度 第5集 - 愛爾蘭
programme.desc: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E6 -Vancouver Island / 迷忘國度 第6集 - 溫哥華島
programme.desc: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: Rooted S1E1 -Memoirs of Acacia / 紮根 第1集 - 相思回憶錄
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: Rooted S1E2 -Sweet Seduction / 紮根 第2集 - 甜蜜誘惑
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: Rooted S1E3 -The Giant / 紮根 第3集 - 參天巨木
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Rooted S1E4 -Rock Splitter / 紮根 第4集 - 開山劈石
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: Rooted S1E5 -The Hollow Heart / 紮根 第5集 - 空心木
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Boss Shark / 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E1 -Food, Glorious Food / 超級鯊魚大道 第1集 - 覓食天堂
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E2 -Love Bites / 超級鯊魚大道 第2集 - 發現愛情
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E3 -Into the Darkness / 超級鯊魚大道 第3集 - 潛入深淵
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E4 -The Social Network / 超級鯊魚大道 第4集 - 鯊魚社交網絡
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark’s most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E5 -Detour / 超級鯊魚大道 第5集 - 中途站
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E6 -Careful, There's Humans Up There! / 超級鯊魚大道 第6集 - 小心！人出沒注意！
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E4 -India / 王者爭霸 第4集 - 印度
programme.desc: Welcome to India – a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries S1E2 -Ivory Wars / 肯亞野生日記 第2集 - 象牙之戰
programme.desc: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide / 潮游國度
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E1 -The Borderlands / 動物「洛」園 第1集 - 邊境之地
programme.desc: Where the mountains cross international borders, herds of elk and moose live side by side with predators like bears and wolves. The predator/prey relationship is a delicate balance, and the perfect place to see it in action is the Kootenay area of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E2 -In the Peaks / 動物「洛」園 第2集 - 山峰之巔
programme.desc: The air is thin and cold, trees can’t even live here -­‐ it’s not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. We’ll take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E3 -The Waterways / 動物「洛」園 第3集 - 水道
programme.desc: Some of mightiest rivers in North America originate on the glacial heights of the Rocky Mountains. The lakes, rivers and marshes of the Rockies are like arteries pulsing through the landscape, feeding the creatures that call the mountains home. Fed by glaciers and motivated by gravity, these waterways are split by the massive Rockies, which divert flow into the Atlantic, Pacific, and Arctic Oceans. From the uninhabitable icy pecks, water melts off glaciers, runs down thunderous waterfalls, filters through wetlands, sculpts the terrain, and finally flows out to the ocean, sustaining life and transforming environments along the way.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E4 -Balancing the Forest / 動物「洛」園 第4集 - 保持森林平衡
programme.desc: Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs can’t grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E5 -Group Survival / 動物「洛」園 第5集 - 族群生存之道
programme.desc: For a great many species, the structures of group living are the most important for survival. Although social living is integral to many of the animals that call the Rocky Mountains home, no two species organize their society in the same way. Even among closely related species there can be drastic differences in social structure; communication, hierarchy, mating, and diet are all inextricably informed by specific environmental and genetic adaptations for group survival.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E5 -The Valley of the Birds / 尚比亞野生故事 第5集 - 鳥之谷
programme.desc: Zambia’s Luangwa Valley is home to Africa’s biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E6 -African Myths / 尚比亞野生故事 第6集 - 非洲神話
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E7 -Chilema and Her Brother / 尚比亞野生故事 第7集 - 智利獁和牠的兄弟
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E8 -Tree Tales / 尚比亞野生故事 第8集 - 樹木傳說
programme.desc: Trees are Africa’s oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths’ most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast / 海洋饕餮盛宴
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet’s biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa’s east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Boss Shark: Chasing Giants / 鯊王爭霸戰：追逐巨人
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E1 -Oceans / 魔幻水域的祕密 第1集 - 海洋
programme.desc: Dive to the darkest depths of the sea to uncover the ocean’s most mysterious inhabitants. Journey across vast stretches of open water with humpback whales, then wander down to the ocean floor to witness breathtaking bioluminescence.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E2 -Coasts / 魔幻水域的祕密 第2集 - 海岸
programme.desc: Venture along Earth’s coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E3 -Rivers / 魔幻水域的祕密 第3集 - 河川
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia’s far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E4 -Lakes / 魔幻水域的祕密 第4集 - 湖泊
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E5 -Swamps / 魔幻水域的祕密 第5集 - 幽沼奇境
programme.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E6 -Frozen / 魔幻水域的祕密 第6集 - 冰封世界
programme.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth’s most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E6 -Frozen / 魔幻水域的祕密 第6集 - 冰封世界
programme.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth’s most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E5 -The Coast / 王者爭霸 第5集 - 海濱
programme.desc: Massive elephant seals go nose to nose to win the title of “beachmaster,” and giant petrels earn the nickname, “murderous garbagemen.” Meanwhile, a female humpback goes to extremes to protect her calf from amorous males.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E2 -Tidal Territory / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第2集 - 潮汐領域
programme.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E3 -Into the Fire / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第3集 - 深入火海
programme.desc: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E2 -Love Bites / 超級鯊魚大道 第2集 - 發現愛情
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Airborne S1E1 -Catching Air / 空中翱翔 第1集 - 乘風騰空
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcon’s speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: Airborne S1E2 -In Flight Meals / 空中翱翔 第2集 - 飛機餐
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owl’s stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamander’s death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala S1E1 -Koala Country / 樹熊異聞錄 第1集 - 考拉之鄉
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australia’s best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1E1 -Sweeping Shores / 「非」一般海岸 第1集 - 險惡海岸
programme.desc: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E6 -Canada / 王者爭霸 第6集 - 加拿大
programme.desc: Canada, where summer is short and time is tight – any time is the right time to fight. The mighty North provides the setting for bison, bald eagles, and polar bears to wage some of the most heavy-duty fighting in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E3 -Into the Darkness / 超級鯊魚大道 第3集 - 潛入深淵
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E2 -Jungle Love / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第2集 - 森愛
programme.desc: It’s not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who’ll risk his life for love.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E3 -A Life Among Trees / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第3集 - 叢林生活
programme.desc: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And what’s it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala S1E2 -Breeding Season / 樹熊異聞錄 第2集 - 繁殖期
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1E2 -Sanctuary of the Indian Ocean / 「非」一般海岸 第2集 - 印度洋的避風港
programme.desc: On Africa's east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recently found population of 'living fossils', the Coelacanth, which dwell in deep, submarine canyons.

programme.desc: From the Amazon to the Andes, South America has some beautiful scenery. From guanacos sparring over grassland, to marine iguanas head-butting over a beachhead, to home-stealing hermit crabs, the quest for real estate causes a lot of conflict.

programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark’s most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E1 -Queen of Yala / 風之島 第1集 - 亞拉之后
programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It’s time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E2 -Loka the Baby Elephant / 風之島 第2集 - 小象洛卡
programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo S1E1 -Mob Rules / 袋鼠異聞錄 第1集 - 暴「鼠」規則
programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1E3 -Golden Forest / 「非」一般海岸 第3集 - 瑰寶之森
programme.desc: This is the story of the “Golden Forest”, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africa’s southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E2 -Loka the Baby Elephant / 風之島 第2集 - 小象洛卡
programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo S1E1 -Mob Rules / 袋鼠異聞錄 第1集 - 暴「鼠」規則
programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1E3 -Golden Forest / 「非」一般海岸 第3集 - 瑰寶之森
programme.desc: This is the story of the “Golden Forest”, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africa’s southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E2 -Jungle Love / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第2集 - 森愛
programme.desc: It’s not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who’ll risk his life for love.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E3 -A Life Among Trees / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第3集 - 叢林生活
programme.desc: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And what’s it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E4 -Lakes / 魔幻水域的祕密 第4集 - 湖泊
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E1 -A Summer to Remember / 野生動物急診室 第1集 - 難忘的夏季
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E2 -A Prickly Problem / 野生動物急診室 第2集 - 一個棘手難題
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala’s spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle’s slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo S1E2 -From Pouch to Foot / 袋鼠異聞錄 第2集 - 從「袋」到腳
programme.desc: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but bringing up baby is fraught with challenges. Predators, climate extremes, and lively joeys mean kangaroo mothers face a daily struggle to keep their young alive.

programme.desc: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins’ daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and hostile environment.

programme.desc: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

programme.desc: Follow several different males as they roam the land, climb up the social ladder, and fight for their mating rights in Eastern Grey colony. For these bucks, the drive to perpetuate their species promises a life full of risk and reward.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E8 -Tree Tales / 尚比亞野生故事 第8集 - 樹木傳說
programme.desc: Trees are Africa’s oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths’ most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Planet Weird S1E5 -Fight Club / 奇異地球 第5集 - 鬥陣俱樂部
programme.desc: Step into the ring with nature’s top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: Planet Weird S1E6 -Gangsters / 奇異地球 第6集 - 野性黑幫
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches who’ve developed a taste for blood.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story / 啄木鳥：樹洞故事
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world’s 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature’s best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E5 -Crystal, Elsa and Thor / 動物知心友 第5集 - 克莉絲朵、艾莎與索爾
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E6 -Ozzy, Riri, and Gaia / 動物知心友 第6集 - 奧茲、瑞瑞與蓋亞
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E2 -Australia / 王者爭霸 第2集 - 澳洲
programme.desc: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E5 -Crystal, Elsa and Thor / 動物知心友 第5集 - 克莉絲朵、艾莎與索爾
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E1 -The Hungry Leopard / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 餓豹傳說
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E3 -Guided By the Moon / 月球野性面 第3集 - 月光指引
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E1 -River of Life / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第1集 - 生命之河
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: Rooted S1E5 -The Hollow Heart / 紮根 第5集 - 空心木
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast / 海洋饕餮盛宴
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet’s biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa’s east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.
