programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E3 -Savanna / 王者爭霸 第3集 - 疏林草原
programme.desc: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether it’s head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries S1E1 -Haven of Giants / 肯亞野生日記 第1集 - 巨人避難所
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. They've also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants’ needs - and to see if they're returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E1 -Iceland: Fire / 迷忘國度 第1集 - 冰島:火
programme.desc: Learn about the world’s largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E2 -Iceland: Ice / 迷忘國度 第2集 - 冰島:冰
programme.desc: Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E3 -Bay of Fundy / 迷忘國度 第3集 - 芬迪灣
programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundy’s surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the world’s fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E4 -Wales / 迷忘國度 第4集 - 威爾斯
programme.desc: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the world’s longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E5 -Ireland / 迷忘國度 第5集 - 愛爾蘭
programme.desc: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2E6 -Vancouver Island / 迷忘國度 第6集 - 溫哥華島
programme.desc: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: Rooted S1E1 -Memoirs of Acacia / 紮根 第1集 - 相思回憶錄
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: Rooted S1E2 -Sweet Seduction / 紮根 第2集 - 甜蜜誘惑
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: Rooted S1E3 -The Giant / 紮根 第3集 - 參天巨木
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Rooted S1E4 -Rock Splitter / 紮根 第4集 - 開山劈石
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: Rooted S1E5 -The Hollow Heart / 紮根 第5集 - 空心木
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Boss Shark / 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E1 -Food, Glorious Food / 超級鯊魚大道 第1集 - 覓食天堂
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E2 -Love Bites / 超級鯊魚大道 第2集 - 發現愛情
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E3 -Into the Darkness / 超級鯊魚大道 第3集 - 潛入深淵
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E4 -The Social Network / 超級鯊魚大道 第4集 - 鯊魚社交網絡
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark’s most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E5 -Detour / 超級鯊魚大道 第5集 - 中途站
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1E6 -Careful, There's Humans Up There! / 超級鯊魚大道 第6集 - 小心！人出沒注意！
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E4 -India / 王者爭霸 第4集 - 印度
programme.desc: Welcome to India – a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries S1E2 -Ivory Wars / 肯亞野生日記 第2集 - 象牙之戰
programme.desc: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide / 潮游國度
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E1 -The Borderlands / 動物「洛」園 第1集 - 邊境之地
programme.desc: Where the mountains cross international borders, herds of elk and moose live side by side with predators like bears and wolves. The predator/prey relationship is a delicate balance, and the perfect place to see it in action is the Kootenay area of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E2 -In the Peaks / 動物「洛」園 第2集 - 山峰之巔
programme.desc: The air is thin and cold, trees can’t even live here -­‐ it’s not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. We’ll take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E3 -The Waterways / 動物「洛」園 第3集 - 水道
programme.desc: Some of mightiest rivers in North America originate on the glacial heights of the Rocky Mountains. The lakes, rivers and marshes of the Rockies are like arteries pulsing through the landscape, feeding the creatures that call the mountains home. Fed by glaciers and motivated by gravity, these waterways are split by the massive Rockies, which divert flow into the Atlantic, Pacific, and Arctic Oceans. From the uninhabitable icy pecks, water melts off glaciers, runs down thunderous waterfalls, filters through wetlands, sculpts the terrain, and finally flows out to the ocean, sustaining life and transforming environments along the way.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E4 -Balancing the Forest / 動物「洛」園 第4集 - 保持森林平衡
programme.desc: Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs can’t grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

programme.title: Wild Rockies S1E5 -Group Survival / 動物「洛」園 第5集 - 族群生存之道
programme.desc: For a great many species, the structures of group living are the most important for survival. Although social living is integral to many of the animals that call the Rocky Mountains home, no two species organize their society in the same way. Even among closely related species there can be drastic differences in social structure; communication, hierarchy, mating, and diet are all inextricably informed by specific environmental and genetic adaptations for group survival.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E5 -The Valley of the Birds / 尚比亞野生故事 第5集 - 鳥之谷
programme.desc: Zambia’s Luangwa Valley is home to Africa’s biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E6 -African Myths / 尚比亞野生故事 第6集 - 非洲神話
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E7 -Chilema and Her Brother / 尚比亞野生故事 第7集 - 智利獁和牠的兄弟
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E8 -Tree Tales / 尚比亞野生故事 第8集 - 樹木傳說
programme.desc: Trees are Africa’s oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths’ most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast / 海洋饕餮盛宴
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet’s biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa’s east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Boss Shark: Chasing Giants / 鯊王爭霸戰：追逐巨人
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E1 -Oceans / 魔幻水域的祕密 第1集 - 海洋
programme.desc: Dive to the darkest depths of the sea to uncover the ocean’s most mysterious inhabitants. Journey across vast stretches of open water with humpback whales, then wander down to the ocean floor to witness breathtaking bioluminescence.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E2 -Coasts / 魔幻水域的祕密 第2集 - 海岸
programme.desc: Venture along Earth’s coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E3 -Rivers / 魔幻水域的祕密 第3集 - 河川
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia’s far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E4 -Lakes / 魔幻水域的祕密 第4集 - 湖泊
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E5 -Swamps / 魔幻水域的祕密 第5集 - 幽沼奇境
programme.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1E6 -Frozen / 魔幻水域的祕密 第6集 - 冰封世界
programme.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth’s most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S1E5 -The Coast / 王者爭霸 第5集 - 海濱
programme.desc: Massive elephant seals go nose to nose to win the title of “beachmaster,” and giant petrels earn the nickname, “murderous garbagemen.” Meanwhile, a female humpback goes to extremes to protect her calf from amorous males.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E2 -Tidal Territory / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第2集 - 潮汐領域
programme.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E3 -Into the Fire / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第3集 - 深入火海

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E2 -Jungle Love / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第2集 - 森愛
programme.desc: It’s not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who’ll risk his life for love.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E3 -A Life Among Trees / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第3集 - 叢林生活
programme.desc: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And what’s it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala S1E2 -Breeding Season / 樹熊異聞錄 第2集 - 繁殖期
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1E2 -Sanctuary of the Indian Ocean / 「非」一般海岸 第2集 - 印度洋的避風港
programme.desc: On Africa's east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It’s time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.desc: It’s not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who’ll risk his life for love.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E3 -Highlight 3 / Trucking Hell 第3集 - Highlight 3
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E4 -Highlight 4 / Trucking Hell 第4集 - Highlight 4
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E5 -Wild Wedding Party / Billy Goes North 第5集 - Wild Wedding Party
programme.desc: Billy and Terry make an urgent call to a wedding venue where wild turkeys are threatening to ruin the big day. Then Billy responds to an apartment where poisonous exotic pets are threatening the homeowner.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E6 -Sting Operation / Billy Goes North 第6集 - Sting Operation
programme.desc: Billy and Beekeeper Ian extract a bee colony from a family home, then Billy has to dodge talons and beak to remove a Great Horned Owl from a house.

programme.title: Feral S1E1 -Copi / Feral 第1集 - Copi
programme.desc: Considered a nuisance and trash fish, the Asian carp has overtaken the Illinois River's biomass and now outcompetes native species. Lucky for Yia, fishermen Clint Carter and Dave Buchanan have devised an ingenious way to rebrand this delicious fish by calling it Copy. Copy is now finding its way into restaurants across the country and Yia gets treated to a shore lunch after his day on the water.

programme.title: Feral S1E2 -Squirrels / Feral 第2集 - Squirrels
programme.desc: When Yia receives an offer to join Ryan 'Backwoods'' Dodd and his mentor, Barry Carter, on a squirrel hunt, he can't resist. Squirrel is hugely popular in the Hmong community and was a family favorite in the Vang household when Yia was growing up. As squirrel hunting has fallen out of favor with the hunting community, Backwoods, Barry, and Yia are excited to highlight this once-fashionable protein--even if it means they have to share.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E13 -Dangerous Jobs (Snakes & Caimans) / Brave Wilderness 第13集 - Dangerous Jobs (Snakes & Caimans)
programme.desc: Coyote experiences the world's deadliest job with Australian snakes and catches a caiman.

programme.title: Save this Shark S1E1 -Save this Shark / Save this Shark 第1季第1集 -Save this Shark
programme.desc: 3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E2 -Northern Territory / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季第2集 -Northern Territory
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E9 -Horses & Dogs / Extreme Animal Transport 第1季第9集 -Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E10 -Camels / Extreme Animal Transport 第1季第10集 -Camels
programme.desc: John runs Red Sun Camels in Broome, a tourist town in the north of Western Australia where visitors can experience a sunset camel ride along the famous Cable Beach. As his business expands, he needs seven more camels to add to the group, to enable his other camels to rest. But camels don’t come ready to be ridden by humans. Without extensive training they can be very dangerous, and the risk of them kicking a tourist could mean serious injury or even death. On the other side of Australia, 5000kms away, Peter has been commissioned by John to train and deliver seven wild camels. Known throughout Australia as the camel whisperer, Peter’s love of the animal is evident. Each of his seven beloved camels has a unique personality. It's a four-day transport. Due to Australia’s strict biosecurity laws, the camels have to pass a quarantine checkpoint at Kununurra, on the border of the Northern Territory and Western Australia. Clair is the government vet who will inspect each of the ani

programme.title: Feral S1E1 -Copi / Feral 第1季第1集 -Copi
programme.desc: Considered a nuisance and trash fish, the Asian carp has overtaken the Illinois River's biomass and now outcompetes native species. Lucky for Yia, fishermen Clint Carter and Dave Buchanan have devised an ingenious way to rebrand this delicious fish by calling it Copy. Copy is now finding its way into restaurants across the country and Yia gets treated to a shore lunch after his day on the water.

programme.title: Feral S1E2 -Squirrels / Feral 第1季第2集 -Squirrels
programme.desc: When Yia receives an offer to join Ryan 'Backwoods'' Dodd and his mentor, Barry Carter, on a squirrel hunt, he can't resist. Squirrel is hugely popular in the Hmong community and was a family favorite in the Vang household when Yia was growing up. As squirrel hunting has fallen out of favor with the hunting community, Backwoods, Barry, and Yia are excited to highlight this once-fashionable protein--even if it means they have to share.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E17 -Sea Turtle Snorkel, Night Ghost Crab Hunt & Giant Gumboot Chiton! / Brave Wilderness 第2季第17集 -Sea Turtle Snorkel, Night Ghost Crab Hunt & Giant Gumboot Chiton!
programme.desc: Coyote swims with sea turtles in Hawaii and catches a giant gumboot chiton in the Salish Sea!

programme.desc: Coyote kayaks with wild orcas, rescues a hooked snapping turtle, and meets a gray wolf!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S6E1 -Terry Loves Superheroes / Hollywood Weapons 第6季第1集 -Terry Loves Superheroes

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E5 -Highlight 5 / Trucking Hell 第2季第5集 -Highlight 5
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S4E5 -Nightmare On Hollywood Weapons / 第5集 - Nightmare On Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: Terry and Larry get to test several scenes from Horror films! Terry wants to test the best way to kill a Zombie, just in case he ever ends up in a Zombie Apocalypse, and they will test a big scene from the horror classic, Freddie vs. Jason!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S4E6 -All For One! / Hollywood Weapons 第6集 - All For One!
programme.desc: Terry travels back in time to see if he can make it as a Musketeer! Can he throw his sword and kill the enemy? Can the cross that he wears around his neck stop a bullet? programme.title: River Hunters S1E3 -English Civil War - Newark Trent / River Hunters 第3集 - English Civil War - Newark Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, head to the vast River Trent and site of one of the greatest strongholds of the English Civil War - Newark Castle. Here on the banks of the waterway in 1645, the forces of King Charles I were trapped in a bloody siege by Scottish forces from the North and Parliamentarian armies from the South. In the first official search of the waterway, the River Hunters will be searching for lost Civil War relics that reveal the secrets of this brutal battleground.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E7 -Reptile Rampage / Billy Goes North 第7集 - Reptile Rampage
programme.desc: Billy wrestles abandoned crocs, snakes and lizards out of a suburban home, then teams up with trapper Mike to remove some prickly porcupine squatters from a cottage.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E8 -I Smell a Rat Infestation / Billy Goes North 第8集 - I Smell a Rat Infestation
programme.desc: Billy comes to the rescue of an unseasoned farmhand whose herd of Ostrich are on the loose. Then Billy and Tim save some house flippers from a red-alert rat infestation.

programme.title: Yukon for Sale S1E1 -Joe and Shelley With AJ / Yukon for Sale 第1集 - Joe and Shelley With AJ
programme.desc: High school sweethearts Joe and Shelly want a log home where they can live off the grid; real estate agent AJ helps them find their dream home.

programme.title: Yukon for Sale S1E2 -Pam and Richard With Jacklyn / Yukon for Sale 第2集 - Pam and Richard With Jacklyn
programme.desc: Pregnant aircraft engineer Pam is looking to buy the perfect home; her wish list includes a rural setting and a lot of acres; a home off the grid and away from neighbors.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E1 -Habitat Conservation / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1集 - Habitat Conservation
programme.desc: From Sydney to the Greater Blue Mountains, Zac and Darin meet with leading eco-warriors to learn about protected lands and habitat conservation.

programme.title: Feral S1E3 -Lake Trout / Feral 第3集 - Lake Trout
programme.desc: In the Yellowstone National Park ecosystem, lake trout are an invasive species destroying the native cutthroat trout population. The highly-prized 'Midwest' fish is one of Yia's favorites and a trip to Yellowstone with Western River Anglers is an adventure he can't resist. Jay Harris teaches Yia to fly fish, with hopes of landing a shore lunch and removing this tasty but invasive trout.

programme.title: Feral S1E4 -Ducks / Feral 第4集 - Ducks
programme.desc: Duck hunters universally agree: diver ducks are not worth shooting because they allegedly taste fishy. Yia joins Quinn, Ashton, and Jacob of the Teton Valley Lodge to hunt a pond in Ashton, Idaho to compare and contrast the flavor profiles of puddle ducks and diver ducks.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S2E4 -Kate Winslet / Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第4集 - Kate Winslet
programme.desc: Oscar-winning actress Kate Winslet and Bear Grylls tackle the Snowdonia Mountains in Wales as Kate discusses her upbringing and career.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E3 -English Civil War - Newark Trent / River Hunters 第3集 - English Civil War - Newark Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, head to the vast River Trent and site of one of the greatest strongholds of the English Civil War - Newark Castle. Here on the banks of the waterway in 1645, the forces of King Charles I were trapped in a bloody siege by Scottish forces from the North and Parliamentarian armies from the South. In the first official search of the waterway, the River Hunters will be searching for lost Civil War relics that reveal the secrets of this brutal battleground.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E4 -Vikings - River Trent / River Hunters 第4集 - Vikings - River Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, take on the vast River Trent, following in the bloody footsteps of the Vikings as they invaded 9th century Britain. programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild S1E3 -Always Bet on Dot / Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第3集 - Always Bet on Dot
programme.desc: Once homeless and a teen-mom, Dot leaves the big city for a much needed adventure alongside Bear Grylls. She's overcome life's biggest challenges but has never tackled the wild. Her emotional journey is a truly inspiring tale of survival.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild S1E4 -Schooled by a Girl Scout / Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第4集 - Schooled by a Girl Scout
programme.desc: When a 13-year-old girl scout needs help earning a primitive camping skills badge, Bear Grylls flies to the rescue… literally. Beth’s wisdom for life and the outdoors is beyond her years, but nothing can prepare her for what challenges bear has in store for this adventure.

programme.title: Spiky Gold Hunters S1E1 / Spiky Gold Hunters 第1集
programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, skipper Dwane leads his crew into the waters of Fiordland on the southern coast of New Zealand. It’s all hands on deck as the divers work relentlessly to collect tonnes of urchin. As the weather deteriorates, of the crew gets a scare from below the surface.

programme.title: Search4Hurt S4E8 -Hyrox / Search4Hurt 第8集 - Hyrox
programme.desc: The hottest new sport of hybrid games sweeping the world is Hyrox, so the team puts their fitness to the test in Melbourne.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E5 -Highlight 5 / Trucking Hell 第5集 - Highlight 5
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E6 -Highlight 6 / Trucking Hell 第6集 - Highlight 6
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese…

programme.title: Le Gout Des Rencontres Normandes:2025 E11 -Wellness Break In Remalard-En-Perche / Le Gout Des Rencontres Normandes 第11集 - Wellness Break In Remalard-En-Perche

programme.title: Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature:2021-2022 E11 -Mercantour / Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature 第11集 - Mercantour
programme.desc: The Mercantour National Park stretches across two French departments, Alpes-Maritimes and Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. Located in the high mountains, it is nevertheless very close to the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Passe-Moi Les Jumelles:2025-2026 E8 -The Croy Trail (2/2) / Passe-Moi Les Jumelles 第8集 - The Croy Trail (2/2)
programme.desc: The next instalment in the journey of Olivier Guignard, an enthusiast of vintage agricultural vehicles, who is driving a 1966 combine harvester from the Netherlands to Croy, in the canton of Vaud. A second episode packed with twists and turns.

programme.title: Echappees Belles S20E1 -Haute-Savoie, A Summer In The Aravis / Echappees Belles 第1集 - Haute-Savoie, A Summer In The Aravis
programme.desc: Far from mass tourism, the Aravis massif is a preserved region straddling Haute-Savoie and Savoie. Here, there are no crowds or vast tourist resorts, simply alpine pastures as far as the eye can see, farms nestled against the mountains and trails perfect for getting away from it all.

programme.title: Donner L'gout S1E6 -Italy In Chelsea / Donner L'gout 第6集 - Italy In Chelsea
programme.desc: Meeting Roberto Catervi, a Roman chef who settled in Chelsea, Outaouais, to open a pizzeria with his wife. He shares the secrets of a true pizza dough and his recipe for pasta carbonara.

programme.title: Silence, CA Pousse !:2024-2025 E27 -Lewis Family/Depolluting Plants/Mauritian Mangrove Swamps / Silence, CA Pousse ! 第27集 - Lewis Family/Depolluting Plants/Mauritian Mangrove Swamps
programme.desc: On the programme: the Lewis family, traditional farming; depolluting plants; Mauritian mangrove swamps; Don't panic with Krystel and Fred.

programme.title: Une Brique Dans Le Ventre:2025-2026 E8 -Revival Of An 1890 House In Uccle / Une Brique Dans Le Ventre 第8集 - Revival Of An 1890 House In Uccle
programme.desc: Head to Uccle to discover the transformation of a family home, completely renovated. The goal? To offer maximum views of the outdoors. Also: the treehouses of Mon lit dans l'arbre, nestled in the heart of the Ardennes; concrete feature with Villa Van Wassenhove; how to create a cloakroom space.

programme.title: Version Francaise S11E22 -Jean Lurcat/Alix Waline/Jacquemus/Alain Ellouz / Version Francaise 第22集 - Jean Lurcat/Alix Waline/Jacquemus/Alain Ellouz

programme.title: Sigabo[Live] / Sigabo[直播]
programme.desc: The series explores the stark contrast in the lives of two individuals: Gabo (Martin), a spunky, street-smart man from a vibrant, humble community, and Samantha (Montes), a tough, fearless law enforcer from a highly affluent and privileged background. It blends action, romance, and comedy as their paths cross and their different worlds collide.

programme.title: Someone, Someday[Live] / Someone, Someday[直播]
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Loyalty Game[Live] / The Loyalty Game[直播]
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.
